description: In front of you are a small cardboard box, a closed laptop, a paper cup, snack packaging, and two pieces of clothing on the table. The left hand pulls the cardboard box closer and holds it steady as the right hand picks up a snack packet and drops it into the box, then lifts a large bottle and places it inside; the right hand then grabs the paper cup and sets it into the box, and both hands add the orange and green clothing on top before the two-hand object (the box) is slid back to the left to clear space around the laptop.
